mapper.insert: INSERT INTO effects_queue (platform, bot_id, group_id, kind, payload, status, retry_count, next_run_at) VALUES (#{platform}, #{botId}, #{groupId}, #{kind}, #{payload}, 'pending', 0, #{nextRunAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE payload = VALUES (payload), status = 'pending', next_run_at = VALUES (next_run_at)
mapper.select: SELECT id, platform, bot_id AS botId, group_id AS groupId, kind, payload, status, retry_count AS retryCount, next_run_at AS nextRunAt, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM effects_queue WHERE status = 'pending' AND next_run_at <= #{now} ORDER BY next_run_at LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE effects_queue SET status = 'pending' WHERE status = 'running'
mapper.select: SELECT id, platform, bot_id AS botId, group_id AS groupId, kind, payload, status, retry_count AS retryCount, next_run_at AS nextRunAt, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM effects_queue WHERE platform = #{platform} AND bot_id = #{botId} AND group_id = #{groupId} AND kind = #{kind}
